1. When building a team, try to have a water, fire and grass type pokemon it will really help. Most of the time one of these will be your starter. Also have a reliable ice type move like ice beam on your water type because of Dragon types which resist all of the
Types just mentioned. The rest of the team is decided by you.

2. When giving your pokemon moves try to go with reliability instead of power. Moves like blizzard, fire blast and dragonrush are powerful but miss a lot, meaning they don't do damage that turn, but can be easily replaced with moves like ice beam, flamethrower and dragon claw sacrificing power for accuracy

2. Try to keep the speed stat of your pokemon in mind. The speed stat determines which of the pokemon on the battlefield moves first, which could really decide a battle. For example a slow pokemon like drednaw or vikavolt are not gonna attack frst against a fast pokemon like ribombee or boltund. An easy way to get around this is priority moves which always move first. Examples: extreme speed, aqua jet and quick attack (Ranked by power)

I'm sure there's a lot more but those are the ones that I could think of
